summary: Kern County lookout dated circa 1940 for the county fire department; removal date unknown; summit remains a communications site per the register.

facts.design: 14x14 cabin similar to a US Forest Service L-4 design on a 30 ft open timber tower (register description)
facts.status_note: The register gives no removal date and says the summit remains a busy communications site. No source describes what, if anything, of the lookout stands now.

events.note: Register says circa 1940 and that it may have been constructed before 1940
July 15, 1941 (Bakersfield Californian item, quoted on Forest Lookouts): the board authorized Surveyor Thornton to survey a site for a new station atop the peak, at Harold P. Bowhay's request

evidence.supports: may have been built before 1940 for the Kern County Fire Department
evidence.quote: Grapevine Peak may have been constructed for the Kern County Fire Department prior to 1940.

evidence.supports: 14x14 cabin similar to USFS L-4 on a 30 ft open timber tower
evidence.quote: The structure appears to be a 14x14 cabin similar to a US Forest Service L-4 design on a 30 foot open timber tower.
The site does not appear on Thornton's 1986 survey

evidence.supports: Ron Kemnow's site lists it as a county structure
evidence.quote: is noted as a county structure on Ron Kemnow's site.

evidence.supports: July 15, 1941 survey authorized by the board at Bowhay's request
evidence.quote: The board authorized Surveyor Thornton to survey a site for a new fire lookout station atop Grapevine peak in response to a request by Harold P. Bowhay.

evidence.supports: summit remains a busy communications site
evidence.quote: Grapevine Peak remains a busy communications site.

evidence.supports: administered by Kern County Fire Department

corrections.why: The register says the removal date is unknown and that the summit remains a busy communications site. No source confirms that the lookout is gone.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says circa 1940 and possibly earlier. A July 1941 newspaper item describes a survey for a new station on the peak. The first build date is therefore uncertain; the brief's 1940 is kept as circa 1940.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: two pages only. The 1941 item is quoted on the Forest Lookouts page and was not checked against the Bakersfield Californian. Searches found nothing on the lookout or the site today, and the only Grapevine Peak hits were unrelated (Nevada peak, I-5 fires). Worth checking Kern County Fire Department history or 1940-1941 Bakersfield papers for build and removal dates.
